gates.name: Data reconciliation to the official record
gates.evidence: 10 of 10 integrity checks pass; 160 of 160 official 2026 W/L/T/PF/PA cells match
gates.rule: Every integrity check must pass before any number is published.

gates.name: Minimum out-of-sample sample
gates.rule: At least 1,000 out-of-sample games before a skill claim.

gates.name: Beats the naive baseline
gates.rule: The model must beat the do-nothing baseline.

gates.name: Beats the closing line
gates.rule: Beating a naive baseline is not skill; the closing line is the real opponent.

gates.name: Survives multiple-testing control
gates.evidence: 7 strategies tested (including placebos); 0 survive Benjamini-Hochberg at q=0.05
gates.rule: No strategy may be called skilful unless it survives FDR across everything tried.

gates.name: Placebos fail (the screen is not too loose)
gates.rule: If a placebo can pass, the screen is too loose to be published as skill.

gates.name: Executable, archived price
gates.evidence: The NFL publishes no betting odds. Every ROI here is priced at an ASSUMED -110; closing lines come from a third-party archive and no price history was licensed.
gates.rule: An edge must be measured against a price that could actually have been taken.

gates.name: Uncertainty reported and bounded away from zero
gates.evidence: 0 strategies have a week-clustered 95% CI on ROI entirely above zero (of 5 priced)
gates.rule: A positive point estimate is not enough; the interval must exclude zero.

gates.name: Profit is not one season in disguise
gates.evidence: 1 profitable strategies spread their profit over seasons; every profitable strategy discloses the share of its profit coming from its single best season
gates.rule: No single season may supply the majority of a strategy's profit.

gates.name: Deterministic reproduction
gates.evidence: Every random draw uses seed 20261113; re-running run_all.py reproduces each derived JSON byte for byte apart from the timestamp.
gates.rule: CI must be able to regenerate every published number from committed code.

scoreboard.note: No reward can be paid while any gate is open.
